subject.title: Memory MVP: build write pipeline with classification, dedupe, merge, and conflict handling

question: Should OpenClaw's recommended memory path add a durable resolver-backed write pipeline in memory-core now, or should this remain deferred until the schema, provenance, and operator review MVP issues are settled together?
rationale: The requested behavior changes how durable memory is stored and promoted, and current main deliberately uses Markdown files plus separate search/wiki layers, so automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Design Memory MVP Together
options.body: Keep this issue open as the write-pipeline design track and resolve it with the schema, provenance, and review-flow issues before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin API Gap
options.body: Convert the remaining work into a smaller plugin/API design if maintainers want third-party memory plugins to own the resolver first.

options.title: Defer Resolver Pipeline
options.body: Leave current Markdown memory, promotion, and memory-wiki layers as the supported path until stronger product demand or maintainer ownership appears.

recommendation.title: Design Memory MVP Together
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the write-pipeline design track and resolve it with the schema, provenance, and review-flow issues before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and memory-wiki history makes this the best available owner for the memory product boundary decision.
